# Claude Plugin Cookbook

> A reference and scaffolder for building Claude Code plugins. The repository is both a
> 15-chapter reference cookbook documenting the whole plugin contract AND the installable
> `plugin-cookbook` plugin itself — whose `/plugin-cookbook:new-plugin` skill scaffolds a new
> plugin from a validated starter skeleton. Everything stays
> `claude plugin validate --strict`-clean.

## What it is

- Reference: `docs/cookbook/` — 15 chapters (00–14), one plugin attribute per chapter, plus the
  BOOTSTRAP playbook and the SOFTWARE-3-0 thesis.
- Starter: `skeleton/` — a minimal, valid, loadable plugin that already passes
  `claude plugin validate --strict`.
- Scaffolder: the `/plugin-cookbook:new-plugin` skill copies the skeleton into a new directory,
  fills the manifest, validates strict, and initializes a clean git history.

## Install

- /plugin marketplace add odere-pro/claude-plugin-cookbook
- /plugin install plugin-cookbook@plugin-cookbook
- /plugin-cookbook:new-plugin my-plugin
